alt: One ensuite bathroom shown from the doorway in five material variations: walnut and travertine, black and marble, pale oak and sage zellige, deep green and statuario, limewashed and terracotta.
text:
materials reshape light in completely different ways in the same room.

five takes on one ensuite. walnut and travertine. black and marble. pale oak and sage zellige—that's the version i study. deep green and statuario. limewashed and terracotta.
